user.title: Add a PowerPool account
user.description: Paste the API key from your PowerPool dashboard. Your username is read from the account automatically.

data_description.api_key: Found on your PowerPool dashboard. Changing your PowerPool password resets the key, and you will be asked to enter the new one.

account.title: Choose an account
account.description: This API key unlocks more than one account. Pick the one to add — run the setup again to add the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the PowerPool API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {username} is no longer accepted. This normally means the PowerPool password was changed, which resets the key. Paste the new one from the dashboard.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach PowerPool. Check Home Assistant has internet access and try again.
error.invalid_auth: That API key was rejected. Copy it again from your PowerPool dashboard.
error.no_accounts: The key was accepted but no mining account came back. Check the key belongs to a PowerPool mining account.
error.account_mismatch: That key belongs to a different PowerPool account. Enter the key for the account named above, or add the other account as a separate integration entry.

abort.already_configured: This PowerPool account is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch account stats. PowerPool reports rolling averages, so polling faster than a minute adds load without adding detail.
